# sigma_team_user_attributes (Data Source)

List the user attributes assigned to a team, with their assigned values.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# All user-attribute values assigned to a given team.
data "sigma_team_user_attributes" "engineering" {
  team_id = sigma_team.engineering.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `team_id` (String) Team UUID.

### Read-Only

- `user_attributes` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--user_attributes))

<a id="nestedatt--user_attributes"></a>
### Nested Schema for `user_attributes`

Read-Only:

- `id` (String)
- `name` (String)
- `value` (String, Sensitive)
